Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread and misreported the refugee count from the cited source. The FamilySearch page states the Dutch Republic received 75,000–100,000 Huguenot refugees after the revocation of the Edict of Nantes, but the Planner concluded “approximately 56,000,” an unsupported and conflicting figure. This data extraction/synthesis error (and premature task completion with inconsistent citation) directly led to the wrong answer.
